name: Ekopak
verdict: Ekopak NV is listed on Euronext Brussels; Marc Coucke controls 57.64% of the votes through Alychlo NV. Nothing found.
note: Belgian industrial water-recycling group. May 2025 transparency filings in the cited PDF: Alychlo NV (Marc Coucke) rose above 55% to 57.64% of votes, Pilovan BV (Pieter Loose) dropped below the 25% threshold to 24.93%.
